data.title: OpenAI touts hundreds of new math results as US official warns of anti-AI ‘psyop’
data.description: OpenAI says one of its internal models found the answers to hundreds more unsolved math problems on Wednesday, publishing proofs for the problems in a public GitHub repository. Meanwhile, billionaire investor Ray Dalio is warning that the AI industry bubble may be about to burst.
